answer: Sorry, the help center doesn't explain how to get a payoff amount or how we work with a lender like Harbor on an active loan, so please contact a store directly for help with that. If your loan is already paid off but Harbor is still listed as lienholder on the title, ask Harbor for a lien release letter. If you can't get one, you can sign our lien release request (form NW-LRL-1) and we'll contact the lender for you, which can add 1 to 2 weeks. We can still make an offer and book your appointment while you wait.
